input.quote: The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ or engage", "induce", "recruit", "personnel", "non-compete" and "directly or indirectly" return no restrictive covenant anywhere in the Agreement; the only employment-related general provision is the independent-contractor clause (p0066), and the sole references to hiring/employment sit in the indemnity and confidentiality provisions. The Agreement therefore imposes no non-solicitation or no-hire restriction on AP (or on either party), which matches the playbook's preferred position of no non-solicit binding Customer. No redline required.
